title: common/error
description: Result envelope shared from bridge boundary to contract validation. DECISION (T041, 2026-09-22): this schema intentionally validates the full result envelope — {ok:false,error:{code,message,details?,retryable}} failure AND {ok:true,result} success — because the live zorrobyte bridge emits exactly this shape and consumers need one schema for both. The failure branch is the normative machine contract (FR-006); never free-form strings.

message.description: Human-readable summary; never the machine contract.

details.description: Optional structured context for the failure.

retryable.description: Whether a caller may retry the failed operation.
